people.name: Manoah
people.line: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.

translations.web: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”
translations.bsb: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
translations.kjv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
translations.asv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
